notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list a Central Navajo Fair in Chinle with August dates and contacts across two pages. Current official information calls the event the Central Agency Fair and confirms Aug. 10-16, 2026 in Chinle. Preserve the source name for CRM matching and the official name/date in this note. Source: handwritten call notes, pages 87/89; current official Central Agency Fair website.
